description: An eight stage shift register, each stage moving its value to the next on a trigger, with a probability control on every stage

params.text: Sets the chance that this stage stores the value shifted into it, 0 to 100%; below that chance the stage keeps its previous value and passes that one along

inputs.text: The voltage shifted into the first stage, a fresh random voltage in the menu range being used at each trigger while this is unpatched
A rising edge shifts every stage along by one
0-10V scales the storing chance set by the knob on that stage, 0V stopping the stage from storing anything

outputs.text: The voltage shifted into that stage at the last trigger

menu: range — sets the voltage span of the random voltages used while in is unpatched: twelve presets from +/-10V to 0V-1V, or custom for a minimum and maximum of your own
scrambled eggs! — feeds every stage from a randomly chosen other stage in place of the stage before it
